text: EXP-001 (UE, FF, SO on the Braess example at demand 6): five of six combinations equal the analytic values within 4.5e-16; UE with link e differs by 6.2e-5 in TSTT (relative 1.1e-7), outside the frozen 1e-6 absolute tolerance
scope: Braess network, gradient projection at RG <= 1e-6
status: confirmatory; verdict contradicted under the frozen rule
limitations: Frozen config tolerance (1e-6) disagrees with protocol item 5 (1e-10); owner decision on a rerun pending

text: EXP-002: adding link e raises UE travel time at every sweep point inside (80/31, 80/9) and at none outside; lower boundary reproduced within 1.3e-15; upper and middle boundaries off by 1.1e-5 and 8.8e-6
status: confirmatory; verdict contradicted under the frozen 1e-6 rule
limitations: Residuals of the size allowed by RG <= 1e-6; derivation itself not contradicted in sign

text: EXP-003 primary: median R(UE) on 6x6 grids at rho = 2 is 0.0232 (one-sided 95% lower bound 0.0213; two-sided 95% CI 0.0208 to 0.0256; n = 100), so H0 (theta <= 0.01) is rejected
scope: Synthetic grid-v1 family, BPR alpha 0.15 beta 4, FF-calibrated demand
limitations: Synthetic family only; exploratory values of this cell's analogue were seen before the freeze (C4)

text: EXP-003 S1: the primary decision is unchanged at RG <= 1e-4 (median 0.0231) and 1e-8 (median 0.0232); S3 absolute calibration gives median 0.0214, lower bound 0.0185 (same decision)
limitations: Frank-Wolfe reference nonconverged on 93 of 100 instances, reported only

text: EXP-003 S2: with linear-in-flow BPR (beta = 1) median R(UE) is 0.0030 (lower bound 0.0027), below delta; the excess depends on cost curvature
limitations: Limits scope of CL-003 to beta = 4

text: EXP-003 secondary: FF exceeds UE in R at congested levels (6x6: paired median R(FF) - R(UE) 0.201 at rho 2, 1.210 at rho 3); at rho = 1 both R are below 0.01
limitations: No confirmatory test on this contrast

text: EXP-004: at capacity scale 1.0 median R(MIX(c)) decreases strictly with compliance c (0.0232, 0.0182, 0.0125, 0.0050, 0), every consecutive paired difference with one-sided 95% lower bound above 0
scope: 6x6 rho = 2, MIX(c) as defined in protocol section 2
limitations: One operationalisation of compliance; link-flow scaling sensitivity (item 17) not run

text: EXP-005 (optional): 77 of 100 4x4 instances at rho = 2 contain at least one single directed link whose removal lowers TSTT_UE by more than 1e-4 relative (Wilson 95% 0.678 to 0.842); all 177 such links confirmed at RG 1e-8; 67/100 at threshold 1e-3
limitations: Effects are small (median 0.003 relative); see D-013

text: EXP-006: on TNTP Sioux Falls the engine matches the published UE (max link-flow difference 1.3e-4 of the largest flow) and R(UE) = 0.0145 at rho = 2, above 0.01
limitations: One network, no population claim; network not considered realistic by its maintainers
